description: Seed exemption set for scripts/check-public-core.sh section 5 (generic author-path residue gate). Set-based, NOT an aggregate-count ratchet: the key is (path, fingerprint, ordinal), so deleting one allowlisted occurrence never creates capacity for an unrelated new one. Every entry's `class` is RE-DERIVED structurally by the gate from the live line; a hand-written label that the source structure does not support is rejected. Entries were seeded from a live full-ledger scan, never from a number quoted in a spec.
